title: Starting a friendly chat online
objectives: Open the conversation with a specific reference to a post
Share your own experience at an appropriate level
Suggest a low-pressure activity and a time

courseTemplate.setting: The partner knows a beginner wall at Eastside Gym. Saturday morning is available.

roles.learner: A beginner climber messaging someone about a post
